modules.title: 同一个 URL 为什么有时不会去源站
缓存怎样改变你看到的版本

items.title: 命中时直接复用副本
items.text: 浏览器或共享缓存找到仍可复用的响应，就能直接返回资源，减少等待和重复传输；请求记录中的结果不一定来自源站。

items.title: 过期后可以重新验证
items.text: 副本过期时，缓存可能向源站确认资源有没有变化；资源没变可以得到 304，变了才取回新内容。更新排错要看命中、重新验证和失效证据。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 缓存保存的是可复用的响应结果；Browser Storage 保存网页在当前浏览器里的用户数据；CDN 是常见的共享缓存与分发层。清理浏览器只能验证本地缓存，不能据此断定 CDN 或源站已经更新；DNS 缓存也不等于网页内容缓存。

lessonPractice.title: 你清空本机缓存后已经看到新 CSS，但外地用户仍看到旧版。下一步先查哪里？

options.label: 检查共享缓存或 CDN 的命中记录、响应头和旧副本是否已失效
options.feedback: 对。本机已更新而其他地区仍旧，范围指向本地之外的共享缓存层；要用外部请求和响应证据确认。

options.label: 继续清理 localStorage，因为所有旧页面都来自浏览器保存的数据
options.feedback: localStorage 保存的是网页数据，不是通用的 HTTP 响应副本；而且本机已经更新，现象也超出了单个浏览器。

options.label: 重新修改 CSS 源文件，不检查请求实际拿到的资源版本
options.feedback: 源文件可能已经正确，重复修改会掩盖资源到底从哪里返回；应先检查共享缓存和响应头。

en.title: Your cleared browser now shows the new CSS, but people elsewhere still see the old version. What should you check first?

options.label: Check shared-cache or CDN hits, response headers, and whether the old copy was invalidated
options.feedback: Correct. A fresh local result but stale results elsewhere points beyond one browser, so verify the shared cache with external requests and response evidence.

options.label: Keep clearing localStorage because every old page comes from browser-saved data
options.feedback: localStorage stores web data, not general HTTP response copies. The local browser is already fresh, and the symptom is wider than one browser.

options.label: Edit the CSS source again without checking which resource version the request received
options.feedback: The source may already be correct. Re-editing hides where the resource came from; check shared caching and response headers first.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请排查这份旧 CSS 是从浏览器缓存、CDN/共享缓存还是源站返回的。检查资源 URL、响应头和不同地点的请求结果；找到原因后再选择失效旧副本或更新资源地址，并分别验证本机和外部请求。不要把 Browser Storage 当成缓存结论。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Find out whether this old CSS comes from the browser cache, a CDN/shared cache, or the origin. Check the resource URL, response headers, and requests from different locations. Then invalidate the old copy or update the resource address as appropriate, and verify both local and external requests. Do not treat Browser Storage as the cache diagnosis.

learning.assumes: You have seen a hard refresh change a page or different devices show different versions of one URL.
learning.outcome: You can use the scope of stale content to distinguish a browser, shared/CDN, or origin problem and choose a matching check.

modules.title: Why one URL sometimes does not reach the origin
How caching changes the version you see

items.title: A hit reuses a stored copy
items.text: When a browser or shared cache finds a reusable response, it can return the resource without contacting the origin, reducing wait and transfer. A request result does not always come from the origin.

items.title: An old copy can be revalidated
items.text: When a copy is stale, a cache may ask the origin whether it changed. An unchanged resource can produce 304; a changed one returns new content. Diagnose updates with hit, revalidation, and invalidation evidence.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A cache stores reusable response results. Browser Storage keeps a site's user data in the current browser. A CDN is a common shared-cache and delivery layer. Clearing one browser tests only its local cache; it cannot prove that a CDN or origin has updated. DNS caching is also not page-content caching.
